# Tier map: one line per athenaeum module, `module tier group`, sorted by module.
#
# Tiers, bottom to top. A module may import its own tier or lower.
#   0 foundation      1 settings      2 policy
#   3 seams (groups storage, access, provider)
#   4 records         5 recall        6 routines
#   7 orchestration   8 surfaces
# Seam rule: access may import storage; storage never imports access;
# provider imports neither.
#
# A submodule of a package is written dotted (storage.routing). storage.local,
# storage.backend, storage.backends.memory and storage.backends.files are tier
# 0 foundation; every other storage submodule is 3 storage.
#
# Checked by tests/test_tier_boundary.py. Upward and seam-to-seam edges that
# exist today are listed in tests/fixtures/tier_exceptions.txt.
